title: [YouPass Collect] - Employment sector shifts across three countries

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar charts illustrate the percentages of the workforce employed in three economic sectors - agriculture, industry, and services - across three countries in 1980 and 2020.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, employment in the services sector increased in all three countries over the 40-year period, while agricultural employment declined. In contrast, industrial employment showed mixed trends, decreasing in Countries A and C but rising substantially in Country B. Notably, Country C maintained the highest proportion of service sector workers throughout the period.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding Countries A and C, in 1980, agricultural employment stood at 20% in Country A and just 6% in Country C, while industrial workers accounted for 30% and 35%, respectively. Services employed 45% of Country A's workforce and a dominant 69% in Country C. By 2020, Country C witnessed services surge to 80%, while agriculture halved to 3% and industry fell to 25%. Similarly, Country A saw services rise to 56% and agriculture drop to 12%, though industry remained relatively stable at 29%.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In Country B, agriculture dominated in 1980 at 56%, with industry and services accounting for only 20% and 25%, respectively. By 2020, agriculture had declined to 48%, while industry doubled to 40% and services rose significantly to 42%.
